name: web-orange-to-blue-pixel-tile-gradient-background
title: Stepped square-tile gradient from white through orange and yellow to blue
whatItIs: A rectangle of large stepped squares fading from white at the top left through peach, orange, yellow and grey-green to vivid blue at the bottom right.
whatItMeans: Warm-to-cool and digital; the blocky steps feel like a low-res sunset.
techniques: Build a gradient from offset rows of tiles.
Cross warm and cool hues diagonally.
Use as a hero, cover or divider background.

vocabulary.definition: A colour blend made of blocks.
A gradient running corner to corner.
A transition from warm to cool hues.
